LiteLLM Virtual Key Model Alias Incorrect Authorization Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of LiteLLM. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of virtual key model aliases. The issue results from incorrect authorization. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges to resources normally protected from the user. LiteLLM Pass-Through Endpoint Code Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of LiteLLM. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of pass_through_endpoints. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of code before it is executed via module import. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. LiteLLM Secret Manager oidc Resolver Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of LiteLLM. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the secret resolution handler. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied input prior to using it to access environment variables. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the service account. CubeWP Forms before 1.1.13 contains an unauthenticated stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject malicious JavaScript by submitting unregistered field names through the public REST route cubewp-custom-form/v1/submit/, which bypasses its own nonce check and saves unsanitized values due to a missing default case in the sanitizer, later rendered unescaped on the admin Leads detail page. Attackers can send a single crafted GET request containing a script payload in a custom form field to execute arbitrary JavaScript in an administrator's wp-admin session when the lead is viewed, enabling full site takeover such as creating a new administrator account. 24/11/2026 24/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:P/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:L/SI:L/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H Gravedad 4.0 8.70 Gravedad 4.0 txt HIGH Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 9.60 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) CRITICAL

Devin Desktop Uncontrolled Search Path Element Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Devin Desktop. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the configuration of the Electron framework. The product loads a script file from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of a target user. Affected by this vulnerability is the function resolvePath of the file server/shared/src/main/java/cn/surveyking/server/storage/LocalStorageService.java of the component File Upload. Such manipulation of the argument basePath leads to path traversal. The attack can be launched remotely. The name of the patch is d469ef73d935ff64fd0cf603cf91b76877af02b6.
